GPU 1108 (5.86) frames: each named node fills a few percent of a frame that is mostly dark wet ground; storm-glass stands below the 1.80 m trainer and glowmoss at knee height. The WD2 judges' path to 7.5 was 'make the nodes bigger'. On: the shipped Blender nodes grow by height_scale (storm-glass 1.6 -> 2.7 m, crown 2.6 -> 3.4 m, glowmoss 1.0 -> 1.7 m, clearings with them) their already-emissive surfaces (glass prisms, fungus caps) glow a little stronger (emission_energy; kept low enough that the violet and teal hold instead of clipping to white), and five or six small copies of the node's own model stand half inside its base (ring_of_main: a fraction of the node's footprint radius, so none lands on ground a player stands on) so it reads as a deposit. The per-node ground lights were dropped after GPU capture G-floor2-harvest-presence: they did not show on the ground and were the performance risk. Visual only; no collider, stock, reward or placement change.
